shorts.title: Slingshot Fails Ranked From Bad to WORST 💀

gemini.fixes:
1. **Replace Mobile Game Clips with Real Fails & Fix the Opening Hook (00:00 - 00:07, 00:10 - 00:13)**
   * **What is seen:** At 00:00–00:01, text reading "GUESS THE PHYSICS" overlays a blurry theme park ride clip. At 00:05–00:07 (#4) and 00:10–00:13 (#2), screen recordings of mobile video games are shown instead of actual slingshot fails.
   * **What is heard:** A robotic voiceover asks "Can you guess the physics before it fails?" (00:00–00:01) and narrates pseudo-physics buzzwords like "speed and zero friction" (00:05) and "low friction, feet gone" (00:10).
   * **Fix:** The title promises real "Slingshot Fails," but showing phone gameplay at 00:05 and 00:10 breaks trust immediately. Replace the weak opening at 00:00–00:02 with an instant high-intensity clip of a real slingshot snap or rider reaction to hook viewers immediately. Remove the mobile game footage at 00:05–00:07 and 00:10–0
